templates.name: Token Vault
templates.description: A token vault program where users create PDA-backed vaults to deposit, withdraw, and manage SPL tokens with proper access control and events.

templates.name: Token Escrow
templates.description: A trustless token escrow enabling atomic swaps between two SPL tokens. Maker deposits token A, taker sends token B, both sides settle atomically.
features: SPL token transfers in both directions
Signer seeds for PDA-signed token transfers
Close constraint on take and refund
Events for all escrow lifecycle stages
